problems.title: Real-time Deforestation & Wildfire Detection via Satellite Imagery
problems.description: Develop a computer vision pipeline that processes multi-spectral satellite imagery to detect early signs of illegal deforestation and active wildfire spread in near real-time, alerting forestry officials via automated alerts.

problems.title: Low-Resource Language Conversational Healthcare Assistant
problems.description: Build an offline-capable multilingual NLP voice & text bot providing triage and maternal health recommendations in regional dialects with low training corpus availability.

problems.title: Adaptive Synthetic Data Generator for Medical Rare Disease Imaging
problems.description: Design a conditional GAN or diffusion model that synthesizes high-fidelity, privacy-preserving radiological scans of rare respiratory conditions to balance training datasets without patient data leaks.

problems.title: Context-Aware Smart Code Reviewer with Security Hallucination Guardrails
problems.description: Create an LLM-assisted developer agent that inspects pull requests, identifies logical edge-case bugs and CWE vulnerabilities, and verifies its own suggestions using static analysis execution tests.

problems.title: Autonomous Honeypot Network for Zero-Day IoT Exploit Harvesting
problems.description: Deploy an adaptive decoy infrastructure mimicking industrial IoT devices to capture novel firmware exploits, log behavioral attack chains, and automatically generate Snort/Suricata defense signatures.

problems.title: Zero-Knowledge Credential Verification for University Hackathons
problems.description: Implement a privacy-preserving authentication protocol using zk-SNARKs that enables students to prove enrollment and eligibility without revealing their personal student IDs, grades, or names.

problems.title: Automated Ransomware Canary & In-Memory Encryption Canary Guard
problems.description: Create a lightweight kernel-level endpoint detection agent that plants deceptive decoy files and monitors file entropy spikes to kill encryptor processes within 200 milliseconds of anomalous activity.

problems.title: Phishing Resistance Sandbox for Corporate Email Attachments
problems.description: Build an automated micro-VM detonation chamber that inspects incoming suspicious emails, renders macros safely in isolated browser containers, and extracts obfuscated credential harvesting links.

problems.title: Peer-to-Peer Disaster Relief Communication Mesh WebApp
problems.description: Develop a progressive web app (PWA) operating over WebRTC and local Wi-Fi direct mesh, enabling community members to exchange emergency resource needs and medical alerts when cellular towers are down.

problems.title: Collaborative Real-time 3D CAD Architecture Whiteboard
problems.description: Build a multiplayer WebGL/Three.js interactive drafting canvas with CRDT-based synchronized edits (Yjs) allowing remote engineers to co-design blueprints without state divergence.

problems.title: Micro-Frontend Analytics Dashboard with Zero-Latency Client Caching
problems.description: Design an enterprise web dashboard utilizing Module Federation and service worker streaming to assemble widgets independently with sub-50ms paint times and offline historical caching.

problems.title: Accessible Voice & Eye-Tracking Web Navigator for Motor Impairments
problems.description: Engineer an in-browser assistive overlay using TensorFlow.js face landmark detection that allows users with mobility restrictions to scroll, select, and type using head gestures and gaze dwell time.

problems.title: Solar-Powered Smart Agriculture Water Allocation Sensor Grid
problems.description: Build an ESP32 LoRaWAN-connected soil telemetry unit combining capacitive moisture readings with weather forecast APIs to automate micro-drip irrigation valves and curb water waste by 40%.

problems.title: Edge Acoustic Sensor for Predictive Factory Motor Failure
problems.description: Design an ultra-low power vibration and acoustic edge sensor running TinyML that classifies bearing wear patterns and broadcasts maintenance alerts before mechanical seizure occurs.

problems.title: Cold-Chain Vaccine Temperature Integrity Blackbox Tracker
problems.description: Create a tamper-evident GPS & BLE thermal logger with cryptographic audit logs that records temperature fluctuations during vaccine transit and triggers instant QA rejection upon threshold violation.

problems.title: Self-Healing Kubernetes Controller for Cascading Microservice Outages
problems.description: Build an autonomous Kubernetes operator that detects circuit-breaker trip storms and dynamically scales fallback mock responses while throttling upstream dependencies.

problems.title: FinOps Multi-Cloud Spot Instance Auto-Migrator with Zero-Downtime
problems.description: Develop an agent that orchestrates zero-interruption container migration across AWS Spot and GCP Preemptible VMs upon receiving 2-minute pre-termination signals.
